newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL STAY TOP WITH 2-1 WIN OVER WEST HAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL STAY TOP WITH 2-1 WIN OVER WEST HAM.

text.p: Liverpool stayed top of the English premier league on Sunday after goals from Stan Collymore and Michael Thomas secured a 2-1 win over West Ham, their seventh win in a row.

Collymore struck in only the third minute, but had limped off with a knee injury by the time Thomas provided the winner seven minutes into the second-half, finishing a flowing passing movement with a shot into the far corner
West Ham did their best to upset the leaders after Croatian Slaven Bilic had equalised in the 14th minute with a header from a Michael Hughes corner.

Julian Dicks hit the crossbar, Hughes was just over with a stunning volley and giant Liverpool goalkeeper David James was forced to save at full stretch from Tony Cottee and Iain Dowie in a revival sparked by new Portuguese signing Hugo Porfirio.
